liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (3 reviews): Remembers the band seeming to change many colors under the lights during this song; Reviewer's only Scarlet-Fire in 33 shows; Phil and Jerry sound locked in together [22][23][24]
- **New Minglewood Blues** (1 review): Mydland is active on Hammond, but Jerry's guitar has not yet taken over [20]
- **Far From Me** (1 review): Fine but a bit sloppy and drunk-sounding, which the reviewer thinks helps [20]
- **Me And My Uncle** (1 review): Has a keen skiffle-style beat [20]
- **The Music Never Stopped** (1 review): Reviewer considers this version beyond argument [23]
- **Black Peter** (1 review): Jerry's final line gives the reviewer goosebumps [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-04-02.sbd-mtx.miller.82310.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 151 min; rated 2.5/5 by 6 [1]. Said about its sound: Matrix likely from the FM broadcast, with excessive crowd noise; Pretty hissy matrix soundboard with lots of audience sound [1][27]
- **gd1987-04-02.140333.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 22 songs; 150 min [2]
- **gd1987-04-02.167354.senn441.lamarre.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 148 min [5]
- **gd1987-04-02.fob.nak700.rolfe.miller.99141.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 151 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [7]

## Around the show

- Describes the spring shows as Jerry's welcome back to the East Coast [18]
- Recalls cold, endless rain outside, and police arresting many fans for drinking beer [22]
- Notes the venue is fairly small [22]
- Describes a great scene inside and outside, despite heavy-handed Worcester policing [25]
- Reviewer got two tickets from a lot scalper for 40 dollars total and sat behind the stage [26]
- Recalls Jerry kicking a balloon during the show [26]
- Calls 1987 neglected for short jams and bland setlists, yet says the spring shows had outstanding energy [18]
- Ranks it among the top five 1987 shows and lists a top ten of that year [24]
- Says if you only get one 1987 show, it should be this one [25]
- Reviewer judges every other Scarlet/Fire against this one, and this one always wins [27]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-04-02.sbd-mtx.miller.82310.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette [1]. Also: Cassettes came from Steve Marcus; Encore sits at the end of the first set so the show fits two discs [1]
- **gd1987-04-02.140333.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) [2]. Also: Two sets of masters were combined to make the show complete; UltraMatrix soundboard file set in 16 bit [2]
- **gd1987-04-02.167354.senn441.lamarre.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Doug Lamarre; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Doug Lamarre's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 441 mics > Sony D5M [5]. Also: A Nakamichi 700 source from Steve Rolfe and Charlie Miller supplies opening Cold Rain & Snow notes and a patch in Space [5]
- **gd1987-04-02.fob.nak700.rolfe.miller.99141.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Steve Rolfe; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB/25th Row) Nakamichi 700 -> Sansui Tricode PCM Audio Processor -> Magnovox VCR [7]. Also: Uploader cleaned up some flaws; the encore is placed at the end of the first set [7]
